scope: Full dot-ls executable. Experimental copies only; project vendor and active development binaries unchanged.
timing_note: Suite timing output is a correctness check only; controlled performance is measured separately after all builds and tests finish.

unit_checks.command: zig build test test-parser -Doptimize=safe --summary all (isolated candidate copy)

relevant_changes: Optional event-based IR is not enabled by dot-ls.
The selected block scanner keeps the same implementation; new scanner specialization targets scalar event consumers.
Bare-name hashing changes can reach duplicate-attribute checks. References already use direct hashing for bare names.
Upstream retained-document validation refactors do not replace the custom dot-ls validation collector.
measurement_scope: Pre-encoded full-text LSP messages through client receipt of diagnostics/completion/hover; full dot-ls process RSS and CPU. No parser-only benchmark.
